question: count places intersecting bbox -9.15/-9.13, 38.70/38.72
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.15 38.70, -9.13 38.70, -9.13 38.72, -9.15 38.72, -9.15 38.70))', 'OGC:CRS84'));

question: building containing point -9.1959 38.6916
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, height, num_floors FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Contains(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.1959 38.6916)', 'OGC:CRS84'));

question: places within 500m of -9.1393 38.7079
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_Distance_Spheroid(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.1393 38.7079)', 'OGC:CRS84')) <= 500;

question: restaurants within Alfama polygon
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.135 38.708, -9.125 38.708, -9.125 38.718, -9.135 38.718, -9.135 38.708))', 'OGC:CRS84'));

question: buildings intersecting Torre de Belém
sql: SELECT b.id, b.names.primary AS name, b.subtype FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.names.primary = 'Torre de Belém';

question: buildings over 50m tall within 1km of -9.1495 38.7250
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, height, num_floors FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE height > 50 AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.1495 38.7250)', 'OGC:CRS84')) <= 1000;
